products.note: Podcast/video promotion; audiogram generation; social media; content marketing

reading.body:
Headliner is catalogued as a video generation and editing product, with no data here on its compute, power, or physical footprint.

The record is a single product entry: a podcast and video promotion tool that generates audiograms and supports social media and content marketing. There is no funding, headcount, model, chip, or facility information attached.

That absence is the useful signal. A company can sit in an AI-adjacent category, video generation and editing, while the data behind it says nothing about whether it trains models, rents inference, or simply wraps existing services. For a site tracking compute and the grid, this entry cannot yet be placed on that chain.

What the data does not cover: where Headliner runs, what it runs on, how much it spends on compute, or whether it owns any infrastructure. The refresh interval of 90 days means the record is expected to be revisited, but nothing here indicates what would be added.
